projectDescription: A Claude Code-powered toolkit that extracts your research papers once into a structured knowledge base, then generates tailored LaTeX resumes, CVs, and cover letters for any job description — with anti-fabrication controls, multi-perspective critique, and AI fingerprint avoidance.
keyFeatures: One-time paper extraction with structured Q&A to build a verified knowledge base
Role-type bundles that reframe achievements for different audiences (academic, industry R&D, national lab)
Anti-fabrication controls: provenance flags, verb discipline, and corrections log prevent overclaiming
AI fingerprint avoidance: banned-word lists, structural anti-patterns, and a 12-item post-generation scan
Multi-perspective critique: five reader personas and eight scoring dimensions
Character-precise LaTeX output compiled locally — no data leaves your machine
Three-session workflow (make-resume → make-cl → critique) for fresh-context quality
Session files as persistent state — recoverable across interruptions
publicApiSurface: config.md — personal info, provenance flags, role types, document preferences
